research.claim: Computer Village in Ikeja is described as the largest ICT accessory market in Africa and draws ICT dealers from across the continent.
Daily turnover at Computer Village was estimated at N1 billion to N1.5 billion in 2020, with many vendors also acting as importers and suppliers.
Nigeria's biggest phone retailers started as single shops in Ikeja and grew to between 19 and 90 outlets, with one chain spanning 12 states.
A leading Nigerian phone retailer founded in 1999 reached 40 outlets by 2014 and was considering bases elsewhere in West Africa.
